raw_findings_and_final_dispositions.original_finding: Owned time_chunk_header_/value_chunk_header_ measurement strings are never destructed by the terminal placement-reader destroy()+mem_free path; new real29-character FIELD exposes the preexisting leak.
reasoning: 5db adds default ChunkHeader destructors for both actual owned headers next to existing inherited-header terminal cleanup. Both header members are constructed before init; no later access follows. Cross-chunk reset is unchanged. ValueColumnState remains normal delete, with independent members.

Reviewed production SSI and resource-test callers use placement-new then one terminal destroy()+mem_free, rather than an ordinary outer destructor, stack lifetime or reset after destroy. No supported caller requiring idempotent destroy/reuse-after-destroy was found. Explicit member destructors are valid in that existing contract; future broader RAII/idempotent contracts would need a larger redesign.

Public CI runs are synthetic merge90db, not standalone c8b. Their two actual Debug/Release jobs each retain six62-byte/2-allocation LSan reports. Fresh standalone public c8b is224 functional passes but process exit1 with360bytes/12allocations. Fresh final5db strict Linux focused224 and reader291 pass exit0 without ASan/UBSan/LSan diagnostics. These local instrumented results do not claim a second separate optimized Release sanitizer run or an all-suite clean pass.

The29-character real FIELD regression remains unchanged in all six row/batch/parallel-requested modes; no name shortening or suppression conceals the allocation. Long-name public/fixed/Java files cross-read216 C++ complete queries plus3 Java scans before the separate12-case timing round.
